name: med-planner
description: Med Planner - Plataforma Web Responsiva de Planejamento de Medicina

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')){fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});}"
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')){fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});}"
